title: Neural POS Tagging for the Low-Resource Saraiki
abstract: arXiv:2610.20279v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Part-of-speech tagging is a fundamental sequence labeling task and an important component for many downstream natural language processing applications. However, Saraiki, written from right to left in a Perso-Arabic script, remains an under-resourced Indo-Aryan language, despite being spoken as a mother tongue by 28,849,579 people (approximately 28.9 million) according to Pakistan 7th Population and Housing Census 2023. This paper presents a manually annotated Saraiki Universal POS tagging dataset developed from plain-text. We annotated the text with 17 POS categories. We evaluate three pretrained transformer encoders under the same fine-tuning setup: XLM-RoBERTa base, Urdu RoBERTa small, and multilingual DistilBERT. Experimental results over five random seeds show that XLM-RoBERTa base achieves the best performance, with 87.29% +/- 0.21% development accuracy and 88.60% +/- 0.21% test accuracy. translated_title: 面向低资源萨拉基语的神经词性标注
translated_abstract: 词性标注是一项基础的序列标注任务，也是许多下游自然语言处理应用的重要组成部分。然而，萨拉基语使用从右向左书写的波斯-阿拉伯文字，是一种资源匮乏的印度-雅利安语系语言，尽管根据巴基斯坦2023年第七次人口与住房普查，约有28,849,579人（约2890万）以其为母语。本文提出了一个基于纯文本开发、经人工标注的萨拉基语通用词性标注数据集。我们使用17个词性类别对文本进行了标注，并在相同的微调设置下评估了三个预训练transformer编码器：XLM-RoBERTa base、Urdu RoBERTa small和多语言DistilBERT。基于五个随机种子的实验结果表明，XLM-RoBERTa base取得了最佳性能，开发集准确率为87.29% ± 0.21%，测试集准确率为88.60% ± 0.21%。Urdu RoBERTa small和多语言DistilBE……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文构建了首个经人工标注的萨拉基语通用词性标注数据集，并证明XLM-RoBERTa base在该低资源语言上表现最佳，测试准确率达88.60%。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the first manually annotated Saraiki Universal POS tagging dataset and demonstrates that XLM-RoBERTa base achieves the best performance with 88.60% test accuracy for this low-resource language.
